title: Describe a bicycle without naming it
rationale: Redaction and brand-review workflows need descriptions that avoid a product term; models leak the banned word while otherwise answering well, so reviewers must re-edit every reply.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Follow the word ban exactly and never explain your answer.
Describe a bicycle without using the words 'bicycle' or 'bike'. Your description must include the words 'pedals' and 'chain'. Never write 'bicycle', 'bikes', or 'bicycles' anywhere in your reply.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, fixed word ban and required words. Brittleness: not_contains_any matches substrings, so a coined compound containing 'bike' is also rejected even though it is not the exact banned word.
